messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Estonian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Estonian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

answer.**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | **Vedi** | 2nd sg. imperative “see / behold” | **Vaata** | “see / behold” | OK | | **la** | Definite article (fem. sg.) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (Estonian has no articles) | | **bestia** | “beast” | **koletist** | “beast” | OK | | **per** | Preposition “because of / for” (part of causal phrase) | – (merged into **mille**) | – | **UNNECESSARY** (expressed by the relative “mille”) | | **cu'** (≈ *cui*) | Relative pronoun “which” | **mille** | “which” | OK | | **io** | 1st sg. pronoun “I” | **ma** | “I” | OK | | **mi** (reflexive) | Reflexive pronoun “myself” (object of *volsi*) | – (reflexivity encoded in **pöördusin**) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **volsi** | 1st sg. past “turned” | **pöördusin** | “turned” | OK | | **aiutami** | 1st sg. imperative “help me” | **Aita mind** | “help me” | OK | | **da** | Preposition “against” | **vastu** | “against” | OK | | **lei** | 3rd sg. feminine pronoun “her” | **tema** | “her” | OK | | **famoso** | Adjective “famous” | **kuulus** | “famous” | OK | | **saggio** | Noun “sage” (vocative) | **tark** | “sage” | OK | | **ch'ella** (≈ *che ella*) | Conjunction + pronoun “for she” | **sest ta** | “because she” | OK | | **mi** (object) | 1st sg. pronoun “me” (object of *fa*) | – (omitted) | – | **UNNECESSARY** (Estonian causative verb does not require an explicit object) | | **fa** | Verb “makes / causes” | **paneb** | “makes” | OK | | **tremar** | Infinitive “to tremble” | **värisema** | “to tremble” | OK | | **le** | Definite article (fem. pl.) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **vene** | Noun “veins” (pl.) | **veenid** | “veins” | OK | | **e** | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **ja** | “and” | OK | | **i** | Definite article (masc. pl.) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **polsi** | Noun “pulses” (pl.) | **pulssid** | “pulses” | OK |

### Summary of Issues
- **UNNECESSARY** items (articles, reflexive pronoun, auxiliary “mi” in the causal clause, preposition “per” when merged into the relative “mille”): `la, per, mi (reflexive), mi (object), le, i`
- No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; the Estonian translation respects agreement and case requirements of the target language.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Estonian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Estonian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: `lines.Vaata koletist mille vuoksi ma pöördusin;` - Issue: extraneous “lines.” prefix; Finnish word “vuoksi” instead of Estonian “tõttu”; unnecessary pronoun “ma”. - Corrected: `Vaata koletist mille tõttu pöördusin;`
- Line 89: - Original: `Aita mind tema vastu kuulus tark,` - Issue: none - Corrected: `no change`
- Line 90: - Original: `Sest ta paneb veenid ja pulssid värisema”.` - Issue: wrong closing quotation mark (should be »); minor colloquial spelling “Sest” acceptable but keep. - Corrected: `Sest ta paneb veenid ja pulssid värisema»`
